stem.text: Which feature explains why haemoglobin is soluble?

A.text: All four polypeptide chains are linked together to form a spherical molecule.

B.text: Each polypeptide chain folds due to interactions between hydrophobic R groups.

C.text: The hydrophilic R groups are arranged around the outside of the molecule.

D.text: The iron-containing haem group of each polypeptide chain is water soluble.
